text:
Conflict card

Concrete input: archival is true, interactive_form is true, context is invoice.

Rule A - Flatten documents requested for archival output. Applies here and requires flatten.

Rule B - Interactive forms must remain editable. Applies here and requires editable.

Incompatible actions: flatten and editable cannot both be satisfied.

Which rule wins for this input?
cost_basis: all terminal provider usage, persisted from first request
